fullContentHtml:
UPESSC Principal Result 2026 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the Result for the post of Principal. This recruitment was released for 111 posts. Applications for the UPESSC Principal Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 21 July 2026, to 20 August 2026. The written examination was held on 24 September 2026. Candidates who had appeared for this exam can check their UPESSC Principal Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 July 2026
  • Last Date : 20 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 August 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 23 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 24 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 14 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 21 September 2026
  • Result : 12 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 3000/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 3000/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Important Links

  • Download Result
  • Download Admit Card
  • Download Admit Card Notice
  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPESSC Principal Result 2026?

UPESSC Principal Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
